stories.headline: Bethesda reveals The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel after eight years
stories.summary: Bethesda unveiled the official subtitle [Sentinel](https://www.pcgamer.com/games/the-elder-scrolls/the-elder-scrolls-6-sentinel-is-finally-made-official/) in a video marking the studio's 40th anniversary. The reveal points toward Hammerfell, but Bethesda says development is ongoing and more details are still some time away. No release date or verified Steam listing was announced.

stories.headline: Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic announces Space Program DLC for November 23
stories.summary: Hooded Horse and 3DIVISION announced [Space Program](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5303130/), a PC expansion adding rocket manufacture, orbital launches, new industries and a 1960s campaign. It is scheduled for November 23 on Steam, GOG and Epic. The base city-builder has also passed one million copies sold.

game.name: Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic - Space Program

stories.headline: Final Fantasy XIV expands EU and NA matchmaking across data centers on November 10
stories.summary: Square Enix confirmed that [Final Fantasy XIV](https://store.steampowered.com/app/39210/) Patch 7.58 will allow Duty Finder, Party Finder and more social features across logical data centers in the same North American or European physical region. The November 10 rollout should make parties and older content easier to find, although maintenance is expected to last 24 hours.

stories.headline: Point-and-Click Showcase brings 35-plus games and a Steam sale through November 9
stories.summary: Amanita Design and Rusty Lake are hosting a PC adventure-game showcase on November 4 at 18:00 CET, promising premieres, release dates and demos for over 35 games. The accompanying [Steam sale](https://store.steampowered.com/curator/46551791/sale/PointandClickShowcase) runs until November 9, with discounts on dozens of point-and-click titles. No unverified discount percentages are quoted.

stories.headline: Vampire Crawlers joins PC Game Pass in the new November lineup
stories.summary: Microsoft's first November Game Pass wave adds [Vampire Crawlers](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3265700/) to PC Game Pass on November 4. The turn-based, deckbuilding spinoff of Vampire Survivors is already sold on Steam, making its subscription debut another way for PC players to try it.

game.name: Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors

stories.headline: itch.io removes bulk AI uploads and adds more granular generative-AI filters
stories.summary: After reporting a surge in game-page creation, itch.io says it deleted several terabytes of mass-uploaded AI material and expanded browsing filters for AI-generated content. The store's clearer exclusion controls aim to help PC players discover curated indie games instead of automated spam. This is a new moderation action, not a repeat of the earlier page-count report.

stories.headline: Age of Wonders 4 launches The Silver Seas and announces a free Steam weekend
stories.summary: Paradox released [The Silver Seas](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5094370/) on November 3, adding the Mercantile culture, Sharkkin and Aqualon forms, and four new spell tomes. The free Manta Update also adds trade routes and revamps naval gameplay. The base game [Age of Wonders 4](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1669000/) is scheduled to be free to play, not free to keep, on Steam from November 5 through November 9.

game.name: Age of Wonders 4: The Silver Seas

stories.headline: Kingdoms and Castles adds much larger maps and ten achievements
stories.summary: Lion Shield's November 3 update gives [Kingdoms and Castles](https://store.steampowered.com/app/569480/) an Extra Large map option of roughly 30,000 land tiles, up from about 9,000 on the previous Large setting. The free update also improves pathfinding, fish and tree simulation, fog of war and memory use, and adds ten achievements for existing gameplay features.

stories.headline: Lightyear Frontier reaches 1.0 with two new regions and story finale
stories.summary: [Lightyear Frontier](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1677110/Lightyear_Frontier/) has officially left Steam Early Access on November 4 after more than two years. FRAME BREAK's 1.0 release adds Sandswept Highlands and Hollow Marsh, expands the explorable world by roughly 40%, concludes the main story and overhauls farming automation and mech customization, including the new Skyblazer flight mode. Existing saves remain usable.

stories.headline: Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core launches Update 3 with Balgorath boss
stories.summary: Ghost Ship Games has released [Update 3](https://www.mynewsdesk.com/uk/swipe-right/pressreleases/dig-deeper-deep-rock-galactic-rogue-core-launches-update-3-3476122) for [Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2605790/Deep_Rock_Galactic_Rogue_Core/) on Steam. The Early Access co-op shooter gains the Balgorath boss, configurable boss-fight modifiers, the Ventura shotgun and linked Quantum Warpfield teleporters. New mission variations, upgrade rerolls and a recovery option after host crashes also aim to make runs more varied and resilient.
